text: Esse app é criminoso! Eles fazem a propaganda de ser gratuito por 7 dias e depois fazem cobranças automáticas no cartão de crédito sem a permissão do cliente!! Usei o app menos de uma semana há dois anos atrás e fui descobri hoje que paguei duas anuidades sem utilizar o serviço! A última cobrança foi de R$114,00. Além disso, não há opção de cancelamento no app e em lugar nenhum! Com muito trabalho e pesquisa na internet, onde há várias reclamações no mesmo sentido de outras pessoas, descobri que era possível cancelar a assinatura somente pelo desktop, entrando no Google Play, porque nem no celular aparecia que eu havia assinado algo. Não baixem de jeito nenhum esse app!!! Serviço desonesto e abusivo!

text: 1. NEVER received a notice for the one year debit after free trial. 2. Cancelled my subscription and on the same day, the money for one year subscription was taken from my account. 3. I am no longer a fabulous subscriber so It is unforgivable that I am paying for that service. 4. Once I tried to solve the issue with fabulous throw email, communicating the situation instead of being writing publicly a complain, I could never get an answer that was not automatic and just making a forward to google play (who keeps saying that fabulous should give a proper respond to users). Is not understandable how an app that defends "healthy life" and "well being", can't even "listen" users and understand why are they dissatisfied. We are all living a really hard situation, a pandemic time and I don't see any worriedness from the app staying with money of unsatisfied people who never even used the app after free trial. IS THIS AN HONEST SERVICE? KEEPING MONEY OF SOMEONE WHO IS NOT SUBSCRIBER? NOT ANSWERING? SHOULD NOT BE A POLICY OF GOOD COMPANIES AND SERVICES THE SATISFACTION OF EVEN THE ONES CANCELLING THE SERVICE? (THEY CAN ALLWAYS BE FUTURE USERS OR SPREAD THE GOOD POLICIES AND VALUES OF A SERVICE). I am one person with less 43.99€ (but it truly makes difference in my account). How many (43.99€ fabulous app kept in their accounts from people in same situation as me?) I tried to reach fabulous. I think this all could have been avoided. Thanks, Jéssica

Se eles estivesse realmente interessados no seu "bem estar", jamais teriam essa atitude. Só mais uma enrolação, pra tirar dinheiro de destraídos.
